title: OL-20261112-91: Burn down the human-action document baseline to zero
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** every PR that touches a document, and weekly via the loop breaker
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/doc-consumers.json::"human_action_baseline": \{\}
**Status:** closed

12 documents still hold lines that tell a person to act (doctrine/doc-consumers.json human_action_baseline; python3 -m foundation docs_audit --humans). For each: convert the instruction into an automatic backlog item or a data-driven check and delete the sentence; lower the baseline in the same PR.

**Evidence:** Five documents reworded so none tells a person to act; human_action_baseline is empty and python3 -m foundation docs_audit --check passes.
